notes:
Tasks: swipe any open task — in Total, Not Accepted Yet, Overdue, In Progress and the rest — to change its status; where there is no quick move, the swipe opens the status menu. You can ask for more time as often as you need once you have accepted a task, and on a task you set for yourself it is granted straight away. The task page now shows the time it was assigned, and every comment shows the time it was added. Reminder options are back — Before, After or Repeat until done — as in-app reminders, and Repeat until done sets its gap with one Every … hours control. A recurring task can now be deleted.

Regularization: attach photos or a PDF as proof. The date picker shows what happened on each day that needs fixing — check-in and check-out times, late, absent or on leave — and the requested times start at 9:55 AM and 7:05 PM.

Approvals: every approval chain now reads as one line of names, each boxed in its colour — yellow with a dot while it waits, green with a tick once approved, red with a cross if rejected.

My Interviews is redesigned: it opens on your next interview, with the candidate, the call and the résumé at the top, what the earlier rounds said below, and your assessment as clear numbered steps with a checklist. A round can be marked No Show, and rescheduled to a new date. A résumé can now be a photo (JPG or PNG) as well as a PDF or Word file, and opens as one.

For the CEO and MD: Go To on Home is now a small button with a + Reminder button beside it, and the day's interviews, tasks and everything else are always shown below it.

My Cashbook is redesigned: your balance and Ask for an advance sit side by side at the top — tap the balance to see how it adds up — and a book can now be deleted from its ⋯ menu; nothing in it is lost, every entry stays on your wallet. Each book opens with a new header showing what it has cost and a PDF button. When you record an expense, the date sits inside the amount box. The PDF opens the Day-wise with category summary straight away.
